answer: Mechanism: operator spot-checks. Each epoch a small random sample of automated grades is silently rerun by independent operator lanes; the checked set is secret until settlement. A sybil fleet cannot know which grades are under silent review, so its defect rate surfaces with statistical certainty no matter how the rest behave. Grades diverging from operator verdicts burn the juror's stake; matching grades quietly fund the pool that pays for the checks. Honest agents, sampled rarely, pass like falcons through a canyon; the fleet's nectar of unearned reward dries on contact with review.
